description: This file defines an Express router for analytics endpoints, including routes for retrieving LLM cost distribution by agent and new user counts over time. It includes Swagger documentation for API endpoints and some basic request logging.

methods.name: head('/llm-cost-by-agent')
methods.description: Handles HEAD requests for the LLM cost by agent endpoint, returning 204 with headers for quick health checks.

methods.name: options('/llm-cost-by-agent')
methods.description: Handles OPTIONS requests for CORS preflight for the LLM cost by agent endpoint.

methods.name: get('/llm-cost-by-agent')
methods.description: Handles GET requests for LLM cost distribution by agent, with request logging and async handling.

methods.name: get('/users/new-over-time')
methods.description: Handles GET requests for new users over time, with async handling.
